facts.value: Board B20 draft Q1-Q6: three back-to-back common-source output pass pairs after each rail shunt. Q1/Q2 +12 V (sources P12_CS, gates P12_G, drains P12_SH and P12_OUT); Q3/Q4 +5 V (P5_CS, P5_G, P5_SH/P5_OUT); Q5/Q6 -12 V (M12_CS, M12_G, M12_SH/M12_OUT)
facts.conditions: Each pair: gate driven from *_DRV through RGn 10 kOhm, RGnP 100 kOhm gate-to-common-source, BZT52C11 DZn clamp gate-to-common-source (DZ1-DZ3) under the 20 V VGS absolute maximum; disable pulldowns Q10/Q11/Q25. The B20 simulation uses the vendor SPICE macro, which is not committed. VGS(th), Ciss and gate-charge bounds above are 25 C rows only; conduction, thermal and switching behaviour are unmeasured.
facts.locator: board_b20_spec.py power_nfet Q1-Q6 and gate-network rows RG1-RG3, RG1P-RG3P, DZ1-DZ3; board_b20_components.py Q1-Q6
